en.why_it_matters: Onishi's first solo album removes the rhythm section and puts every choice of attack, space and harmonic weight in the foreground. Hearing her move between Geri Allen, Ellington and standards tied to Fitzgerald and Holiday makes this a concentrated statement about an assertive Japanese pianist reading American lineage in her own language.
en.trip_verdict: If Tokyo overlaps January 9, make room for one set; the late show fits cleanly into a city evening. From outside Kanto, fold it into a broader Tokyo stay rather than travel solely for a recital that also tours other Japanese cities.

es.why_it_matters: El primer álbum solista de Onishi elimina la sección rítmica y deja al frente cada decisión de ataque, espacio y peso armónico. Escucharla pasar por Geri Allen, Ellington y estándares ligados a Fitzgerald y Holiday concentra la mirada de una pianista japonesa contundente sobre el linaje estadounidense, pero desde un idioma propio.
es.trip_verdict: Si Tokio coincide con el 9 de enero, haría espacio para uno de los sets; la función tardía cabe bien en una noche de ciudad. Desde fuera de Kanto, lo integraría a una estancia más amplia en Tokio en vez de viajar sólo por un recital que también recorre otras ciudades japonesas.

events.factual_description: National Sawdust presents Emily Wells' Mirror Father as a workshop performance on February 3, 2027, with doors at 6:30 PM and the seated program at 7:30 PM. The showing follows a two-day residency and develops an experimental opera built around a closeted 'mirror father' and a 'phantom daughter,' linking family secrecy to AIDS, climate, queerness and capital. Raja Feather Kelly directs and Gideon Crevoshay performs the Mirror Father. An exact ticket price was not exposed in accessible official source text and remains unknown.

events.factual_description: Roulette presents the world premiere of Annea Lockwood and Nate Wooley's A Sound Map of the Columbia River on February 5 and 6, 2027, with doors at 7:00 PM and performances at 8:00 PM. The three-hour 5.1-surround work draws on two years of recording across three trips and more than 1,400 river miles using stereo microphones, shotgun microphones and hydrophones, with a bespoke map by Susan Huyser. Roulette lists $25 advance, $30 door and $20 student/senior tickets.

en.why_it_matters: Lockwood and Wooley have spent two years listening along more than 1,400 miles of the Columbia with stereo rigs, directional microphones and hydrophones, then built those encounters into a three-hour 5.1 environment. The premiere offers the rare chance to hear a major living sound artist treat a river not as atmosphere but as a complex, spatial instrument.
en.trip_verdict: Choose either night and make room for the full duration if New York is in play; the piece needs an unhurried evening. From the DMV, pair it with another strong New York date unless this kind of deep-listening sound work is a central reason for the trip.

es.why_it_matters: Lockwood y Wooley pasaron dos años escuchando más de 1.400 millas del Columbia con equipos estéreo, micrófonos direccionales e hidrófonos, y convirtieron esos encuentros en un entorno 5.1 de tres horas. El estreno permite oír a una gran artista sonora viva tratar al río no como ambiente, sino como instrumento espacial y complejo.
es.trip_verdict: Escogería cualquiera de las dos noches y reservaría la duración completa si Nueva York ya está en juego; la obra necesita una velada sin prisa. Desde el DMV, la combinaría con otra fecha fuerte en Nueva York salvo que este tipo de escucha profunda sea una razón central del viaje.
